articles.title: Show HN: Awsmux – Multi-account AWS CLI, up to 5.4x faster, 7.4x fewer tokens
articles.summary: awsmux fans one AWS CLI command out across hundreds of accounts and regions in parallel and merges the results into a single stream. There's an MCP server built in for agents. In a 150-session benchmark, agents using awsmux beat agents using the raw AWS CLI in every test: up to 5.4x faster, up to 2.9x cheaper, up to 7.4x fewer tokens. Single Go binary, stdlib plus cobra only. Feedback welcome. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49051043 Points: 6 # Comments: 0
